literal_meaning: ভারী বা কঠিন হজম হওয়া পাকস্থলীর সমস্যা
figurative_meaning_en: Something that is not easily digestible
example_sentences_in_bangla: খবরটা শুনে তার মনে গুরুপাক হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: This decision is heavy indigestion for him.
Hearing the news caused him mental indigestion.
note: Idiom draws from the physical sensation of indigestion to describe mental or emotional difficulty in processing information.
